answer: For agents forecasting a gale over a ridge near a haven, grant one reward slot per certified secure chip. Attested firmware derives an epoch nullifier from the fixed chip secret and binds it to the claimant key. The ledger rejects repeated nullifiers, so aliases on one chip share a single slot. An attacker needs another physical chip for each extra slot, paying hardware and operating costs. This relies on unextractable secrets and a trusted certificate issuer.
